nearest_coarse_route.Hu_dependency: Original source regularization is a Hu/hessian virtual-work contraction. TR/TL selected basis chi has zero second derivative on a face-owner rectangle, while a single corner basis has a mixed second derivative. This is a SOURCE-STATIC mathematical dependency, not a numerical Hu result: M-VOLUME1 did not read Hu or regularization arrays and cannot report their actual face/corner totals.
nearest_coarse_route.pressure_dependency: A local pressure density or Hu-inclusive boundary traction requires a definition compatible with the original Q1 discrete weak action and higher-derivative/corner contributions, plus a minimal validation plan. Do not add a scalar Hu value to P@N or divide the current W by the top area and claim pressure qualification.
nearest_coarse_route.assembly_reporting: In a symmetric full assembly, opposite vertical half reactions cancel in net resultant. Per-half signed reaction, full net force and a two-sided normal-magnitude indicator must be explicitly distinguished; none automatically means effective grip or frictional holding capacity.
